name: Crazy
overview: Scripture addresses the concept of madness and irrational behavior in various contexts, highlighting its consequences and spiritual implications. Some passages describe foolish or perverse speech as a form of madness, while others warn against false prophets who claim divine inspiration but are truly mad and must be restrained. The world may label Christ as mad, yet God’s love is demonstrated supremely through the giving of His Son for eternal life. Additionally, moral failings and their repercussions, such as those involving personal relationships, reveal the serious outcomes of improper conduct.
